title: Oven Baked Greek Lamb Kebabs
description: A tangy and fluffy Greek dish featuring lamb kebabs with tomato sauce, perfect for a date night, and low-carb-friendly. This recipe is easy to make and requires minimal ingredients.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, salt, and pepper.
Add the lamb pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the lamb pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake the kebabs in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until cooked through.
While the kebabs are baking, heat the tomato sauce in a saucepan over medium heat.
Stir in the crumbled feta cheese and chopped parsley into the tomato sauce.
Serve the kebabs with the tomato sauce spooned over the top.
